source_name: Капитал Банка АД Скопје — Финансиски извештаи / ревизорски извештај
why_relevant: Small MK bank publishing audited statements with the auditor's report and annual report bundled (e.g. FY2023 pack). Small-bank filings matter for consolidation and licence-exit watch.

source_name: Развојна банка на Северна Македонија АД Скопје (МБДП) — корпоративни извештаи
why_relevant: 100% state-owned development bank; not a commercial IR case but its annual reporting reveals state credit-support programmes, guarantee schemes and export finance that shape commercial banks' competitive environment. Its /mk/AboutUs/BankProfil section carries the profile and reporting.

source_name: НБРСМ — регистар/список на банки во Република Северна Македонија
why_relevant: The central bank's per-institution pages (one .nspx article per licensed bank, e.g. Централна кооперативна банка, Силк Роуд Банка, Капитал банка, Развојна банка) are the authoritative actor map for this cell: they enumerate every licensed bank with its legal name and official website, which is exactly the seed list an IR-section crawler needs. Use as the pointer that keeps the bank universe complete as licences change.

source_name: SEC/SRIS Македонија (sec.gov.mk / sris.sec.gov.mk) — депонирани извештаи на банки
why_relevant: The Securities and Exchange Commission's reporting system holds bank-filed drafts and statements (e.g. Шпаркасе нацрт консолидирани финансиски извештаи as Document_SR43-2023-431399.pdf) that sometimes appear here before or instead of on the bank's own site. Good redundancy layer for the cell.

source_name: SEINET (seinet.com.mk) — систем за електронско известување на издавачи
why_relevant: SEINET is the electronic notification system MK listed issuers use to file; bank annual/audited reports are served from it via numeric FileServer ids (observed for Комерцијална банка). It is the machine-facing layer under the exchange disclosures and is the most automatable ingestion point for this cell.

source_name: CompanyWall Македонија — профили на банки (финансиски и регистарски податоци)
why_relevant: Commercial registry aggregator with per-bank profile pages (Халкбанк, ТТК, Шпаркасе, ПК Банка). Reveals-indirectly: registry identifiers, filed accounts summaries and ownership metadata that let you tie an IR document to a legal entity. Commercial terms apply.

source_name: NLB Group Investor Relations — Financial Reports (annual & interim, EN)
why_relevant: NLB d.d. Ljubljana owns ~86.97% of NLB Banka AD Skopje. Group annual reports carry a per-market segment section for North Macedonia with total assets, net profit, market share, client counts and strategy commentary that is not published locally in this comparative form.

source_name: NLB Group — NLB Group Markets: NLB Banka Skopje country page
why_relevant: Group-maintained English KPI card for the MK subsidiary (market share by total assets, active clients, result after tax, total assets). A fast, structured, refreshed snapshot of MK subsidiary scale straight from the parent.

source_name: Ljubljana Stock Exchange SEOnet — NLB d.d. regulated disclosures
why_relevant: Statutory disclosure channel for NLB d.d. Inside information about the MK subsidiary (capital injections, acquisitions, dividend flows from Skopje) must be filed here before or alongside any IR-site publication. Acts as the earliest-warning pointer into NLB's MK-relevant events.

source_name: ProCredit Holding — Disclosure (Pillar 3) Reports
why_relevant: Pillar 3 disclosure gives country-by-country reporting (CBCR) — MK-level turnover, profit before tax, tax paid and headcount — a rare hard number set for a foreign-owned MK bank, mandated by CRR Art. 89.

source_name: Türkiye Halk Bankası A.Ş. — Investor Relations (EN)
why_relevant: Parent of Halkbank AD Skopje (~99.0–99.5% stake). Halk Banka AD Skopje and Halk Osiguruvanje AD Skopje are fully consolidated, so the parent's consolidated IFRS statements and integrated annual report carry MK subsidiary line items and strategy statements.

source_name: Halkbank T.R. — Disclosure of Material Events page / KAP filings
why_relevant: Halkbank's own disclosure policy states material events flow to Borsa İstanbul and KAP (Kamuyu Aydınlatma Platformu). Capital increases in, or disposal of, the Skopje subsidiary would appear here first. Pointer to kap.org.tr as the authoritative Turkish filing archive.

source_name: Kamuyu Aydınlatma Platformu (KAP) — Turkish Public Disclosure Platform
why_relevant: The statutory filing archive for all Borsa İstanbul issuers, including HALKB. Every financial report and material-event notice affecting the MK subsidiary is deposited here, usually earlier and in machine-listable form compared with the bank's own IR site.

source_name: Steiermärkische Sparkasse — Southeast Europe / group reporting
why_relevant: Steiermärkische Sparkasse (Graz, ~EUR 14.4bn balance sheet) is the owner of Sparkasse Bank AD Skopje — now the merged Sparkasse + Ohridska Banka entity and the 4th/5th largest MK banking group (~13.4% market share in 2025). Its Geschäftsbericht is the only place the MK operation is discussed as a group segment.

source_name: Ohridska Banka AD Skopje — Steiermärkische group page (mk/en)
why_relevant: Legacy site of Ohridska Banka documenting the 2019 change of ownership to the Sparkasse/Steiermärkische group and the 2020–21 merger with Sparkasse Banka Makedonija. Useful for ownership-history reconstruction and for the local-language framing of the parent relationship.

source_name: Erste Group — North Macedonia international desk page
why_relevant: Erste Group is the umbrella savings-bank group behind Steiermärkische; its MK desk page positions Sparkasse Bank AD Skopje within the Erste network. Erste's own IR/annual reporting does not consolidate MK as a core market, so this page marks the boundary of Erste-level MK disclosure.

source_name: Chimimport AD — Financial sector: CCB AD Skopje
why_relevant: Chimimport AD (Sofia, BSE-listed) is the ultimate controlling holding above Central Cooperative Bank AD Sofia, which owns ~82.6% of Centralna Kooperativna Banka AD Skopje. Chimimport's holding-level reporting therefore contains the MK bank as a consolidated participation — a second, ultimate-owner reporting layer above the direct parent.

source_name: Central Cooperative Bank AD Sofia — Annual Report (EN)
why_relevant: Direct parent of CCB AD Skopje. The Sofia group annual report consolidates the MK subsidiary and discloses group total assets plus subsidiary-level participations; the English edition is the accessible channel for MK-relevant numbers not separately published in Skopje.

source_name: National Bank of Greece — Group Investor Relations (parent of Stopanska Banka AD Skopje)
why_relevant: NBG has held the majority of Stopanska Banka AD Skopje (2nd largest MK bank, ~16.8% market share in 2025) since 2000 alongside EBRD/IFC. NBG group results presentations and annual reports carry international/SEE segment disclosure covering the MK unit, and any divestment would be announced here first.

source_name: Stopanska Banka AD Skopje — Podatoci i izveshtai (Data and Reports)
why_relevant: The MK subsidiary's own statutory reporting hub — consolidated and standalone audited financial statements and the Годишен извештај. Needed as the local-language counterpart to reconcile against the NBG group-level segment figures and detect where parent disclosure and local disclosure diverge.

source_name: Halkbank AD Skopje — Annual reports (local PDF archive, mk/en)
why_relevant: Subsidiary-level annual reports published as stable PDF paths (observed pattern /content/pdf/<year>/...). These give the MK-only P&L, ROE and asset base that must be reconciled with the Turkish parent's consolidated figures.

source_name: Macedonian Stock Exchange (MSE) — issuer pages for listed banks
why_relevant: MSE issuer pages aggregate ownership structure, shareholder lists and mandatory issuer announcements for the listed MK bank subsidiaries (NLB Banka, Stopanska banka, Komercijalna banka). The definitive pointer for confirming which parent holds what percentage and when it changes.

source_name: National Bank of the Republic of North Macedonia — bank registry entries (ownership/parent)
why_relevant: The supervisor's per-bank registry pages state the licensed entity name, shareholders and the dominant foreign owner. Authoritative cross-check on which foreign parent group to track for each MK bank, and the trigger for noticing an owner change.

source_name: Silk Road Capital AG / Silk Road Bank AD Skopje — owner disclosure
why_relevant: Silk Road Bank AD Skopje (ex-Kreditna Banka, ex-Alpha Bank Skopje 2000–2016) is owned by Swiss Silk Road Capital AG — a private, unlisted owner with no IR function. The bank's own site is the only channel; establishes the boundary case where the 'foreign parent IR' channel does not exist.

source_name: SeeNews — company profiles and earnings items for MK banks
why_relevant: English-language SEE business wire that reports MK bank results, ownership changes and parent-group transactions (e.g. Ohridska Banka/Sparkasse merger approval) faster and in English than either the MK subsidiary or the parent's IR pages. Good change-detection tripwire for parent-level M&A affecting MK.

source_name: ECB Banking Supervision — List of Supervised Entities (annex of changes)
why_relevant: Monthly list identifying euro-area significant institutions and their group structures. Relevant for ProCredit Holding, NBG and Erste/Sparkassengruppe, and useful to detect group-perimeter changes upstream of the MK subsidiaries before they are announced commercially.

source_name: TheBanks.eu — MK bank profiles with ownership and financials
why_relevant: Third-party aggregator carrying standardised English profiles for every MK bank including parent ownership and headline financials. Useful as a reconciliation layer and for quickly re-establishing the MK bank ↔ foreign parent mapping across the whole sector.
